nodes.label: CyberAlchemy
nodes.plain_language: The Product that offers AlchLang governed domain modeling.
nodes.claim: A source-bound projection anchors the capability without redefining the Product.
nodes.owner_route: CyberAlchemy v2 product owner
nodes.forbidden_collapse: Not AlchLang, DomainSpec, a compiler, an agent, or product proof.

nodes.label: Model Governed Domains With AlchLang
nodes.plain_language: Let a domain owner describe a world precisely enough that later software and agents can be constrained by its reviewed meaning.
nodes.claim: AlchLang preserves explicit domain terms, typed edges, rules, behavior, examples, gaps, owners, and authority limits before formal system construction.
nodes.owner_route: CyberAlchemy v2 product owner plus Language Project owner
nodes.forbidden_collapse: Not a parser, CLI, DomainSpec profile, generated graph, implementation, permission, or adoption decision.

nodes.label: Domain Owner
nodes.plain_language: The person or owner group responsible for the bounded domain meaning and consequential decisions.
nodes.claim: Only the named domain owner may accept or reject the intended domain meaning.
nodes.owner_route: Owner of each bounded domain
nodes.forbidden_collapse: Not automatically a runtime operator, implementer, or effect authorizer.

nodes.label: Domain Participant
nodes.plain_language: A human, traditional software component, or agent whose actions are described or constrained by the domain model.
nodes.claim: Participation does not grant permission beyond the separately resolved authority envelope.
nodes.owner_route: Owner of the bounded participation context
nodes.forbidden_collapse: Not an authority grant, trusted agent, or implementation identity.

nodes.label: System Builder
nodes.plain_language: The future consumer that constructs a system from reviewed domain meaning through D65.
nodes.claim: The builder consumes a bounded handoff without acquiring ownership of business meaning.
nodes.owner_route: Future Project and DomainSpec construction owners
nodes.forbidden_collapse: Not the domain owner, compiler, implementation, or conformance owner.

nodes.label: Shared Domain Meaning
nodes.plain_language: People and systems can refer to the same reviewed bounded concepts and relationships.
nodes.claim: Meaning remains source-, owner-, and context-qualified instead of inferred from repeated spelling.
nodes.owner_route: Named bounded-domain meaning owner
nodes.forbidden_collapse: Not proof of universal understanding or canonical promotion.

nodes.label: Bounded Action Environment
nodes.plain_language: Humans, software, and agents can later act inside explicit domain constraints instead of relying only on prompts.
nodes.claim: The model describes constraints but grants no execution authority.
nodes.owner_route: CyberAlchemy v2 product owner plus bounded effect owner
nodes.forbidden_collapse: Not an executable runtime, permission, safety proof, or external effect.

nodes.label: Traceable Domain Construction
nodes.plain_language: Every later system term and edge can trace to reviewed domain meaning and exact D65 predecessors.
nodes.claim: Traceability prepares evaluation but does not prove conformance or correctness.
nodes.owner_route: AlchLang capability owner plus future construction owners
nodes.forbidden_collapse: Not a compiled graph, system ontology, implementation binding, or conformance receipt.

nodes.label: AlchLang Domain Description Input Contract
nodes.plain_language: A bounded description containing explicit or visibly unresolved terms, typed edges, rules, states, transitions, events, permissions, examples, sources, owners, and authority limits.
nodes.claim: Missing required meaning remains an open question or blocks completion; it is never silently inferred as accepted.
nodes.owner_route: AlchLang capability owner plus bounded-domain owner
nodes.forbidden_collapse: Not arbitrary prose accepted as truth, a parser contract, or a DomainSpec source.

nodes.label: Governed Domain Model Output Contract
nodes.plain_language: A reviewable business model with closed term and edge references, explicit rules, examples, gaps, provenance, owners, and authority ceiling.
nodes.claim: The output preserves business meaning without claiming system realization.
nodes.owner_route: AlchLang capability owner plus bounded-domain owner
nodes.forbidden_collapse: Not a generated system ontology, executable tool surface, or acceptance decision.

nodes.label: AlchLang Construction Handoff Output Contract
nodes.plain_language: A future exact binding from reviewed domain meaning to one DomainSpec project, profile, language epoch, and source set.
nodes.claim: The handoff remains blocked until its reviewed predecessor identities and digests exist.
nodes.owner_route: AlchLang capability owner plus future DomainSpec construction owner
nodes.forbidden_collapse: Not a complete ConstructionBinding, DomainSpec admission, or implementation authorization.

nodes.label: Explicit Meaning And Ambiguity Policy
nodes.plain_language: Prefer explicit bounded context and owner-confirmed meaning; preserve conflict, uncertainty, and absence as visible residue.
nodes.claim: AlchLang must fail closed when a selected term, edge, rule, owner, or authority dependency is missing or ambiguous.
nodes.owner_route: AlchLang capability owner plus bounded-domain owner
nodes.forbidden_collapse: Not permission for an agent or compiler to resolve meaning autonomously.

nodes.label: Governed Domain Description
nodes.plain_language: The owner-qualified semantic input for one bounded domain.
nodes.claim: The description keeps required semantic categories and gaps visible before construction.
nodes.owner_route: Bounded-domain owner
nodes.forbidden_collapse: Not unrestricted natural language, accepted ontology, or DomainSpec source.

nodes.label: Ontology Term
nodes.plain_language: A named domain concept with meaning, context, source, owner, and disposition.
nodes.claim: Every required term is resolved, specialized, proposed, or visibly open.
nodes.owner_route: Named bounded-domain meaning owner
nodes.forbidden_collapse: Not automatically canonical, universally shared, or a system type.

nodes.label: Ontology Edge
nodes.plain_language: A typed directional relationship between two domain terms with a business sentence and owner.
nodes.claim: Every edge resolves both endpoints and keeps its semantic relation distinct from later system connections.
nodes.owner_route: Named bounded-domain meaning owner
nodes.forbidden_collapse: Not an untyped association, implementation dependency, or generated graph edge.

nodes.label: Domain Example
nodes.plain_language: A concrete positive, negative, boundary, or missing-information situation used to expose intended meaning.
nodes.claim: Examples constrain interpretation but do not silently replace general rules.
nodes.owner_route: Bounded-domain owner
nodes.forbidden_collapse: Not a complete test suite, proof, or implementation fixture.

nodes.label: Required Term Coverage
nodes.plain_language: Every required concept has an explicit disposition and owner or remains visibly open.
nodes.claim: A complete-looking description may not omit unresolved required terms.
nodes.owner_route: AlchLang capability owner
nodes.forbidden_collapse: Not proof that open-ended human intent is complete.

nodes.label: Typed Edge Closure
nodes.plain_language: Every ontology edge has one known type and two resolvable endpoints or blocks completion.
nodes.claim: Dangling, untyped, or directionally ambiguous edges cannot cross into construction as accepted meaning.
nodes.owner_route: AlchLang capability owner plus bounded-domain owner
nodes.forbidden_collapse: Not proof that the relation is true or that a system relation is conformant.

nodes.label: Authority Preservation
nodes.plain_language: Language, validation, generation, agents, and compiled artifacts preserve authority limits without acquiring authority.
nodes.claim: No later representation may turn a descriptive rule into permission merely by compiling it.
nodes.owner_route: CyberAlchemy v2 product owner plus bounded effect owner
nodes.forbidden_collapse: Not an authority engine, permission grant, or runtime enforcement proof.

nodes.label: Future DomainSpec Construction Boundary
nodes.plain_language: The future exact transition from reviewed AlchLang business meaning to DomainSpec authored system source.
nodes.claim: The boundary is absent until exact project, profile, language, source-set, owner decision, and predecessor digests exist.
nodes.owner_route: AlchLang capability owner plus future DomainSpec construction owner
nodes.forbidden_collapse: Not DomainSpec source, compiler output, system ontology, ConstructionBinding, or implementation authority.
